name: c1_01-joystick
note: U-06: a scripted joystick on device 0 (joystick_script.py; caps with Z, R and POV, 8 buttons), legacy C1_01, no keyboard: centre to 99; Y forward 100-199; X left, sweep right, back 200-439; Z (throttle) down and up 440-639; R (rudder) both ways 640-879; hat up, right, down, left 25 frames each from 880; buttons 1-8 for 10 frames each from 1000 (gaps of 10); Y back 1160-1259; centre to 1399.
